findings: Attrition/minimum assembly quantity is required, but these pages do not provide a numeric R13 0201 minimum. Ten retail pieces are not established as sufficient.
Restrictions on combining inventory sources apply to the same JLCPCB part number; do not generalize this into a ban on mixed sourcing of different BOM items.
Terms list overseas consignment service charges of USD85 for 1-50 part numbers.
Overseas guide lists import handling at 2% of declared value, minimum USD10 per shipment, plus duty and import VAT.
Guide 30%/minimumUSD30 fee is for retrieval, not incoming consignment.
fee_reconciliation: The pages do not establish whether USD85 and the import handling charge are additive or alternative for this planned route. Do not sum them into a supposedly confirmed quote.
design_procurement_decision: Keep seller-installed TH1 out of automated SMT and out of overseas consignment quantities.
Treat R13 retail pricing as an alternative procurement observation; compare the exact MPN in assembler stock/global sourcing before selecting overseas consignment.
Do not use retail part subtotal as delivered assembled cost.
